answer: The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. No Corkbound claret edger cork writ, no seat: the rule is plain, and a writ claret edgers sign after wine cellar audits is why it holds. For every name, a toll of 22 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down leaves the farm's purse before the first reward appears. The defence is the price itself, and the price does not negotiate. One comet, one entry. The clerk notes sable. tundra stays on the record.
